ITEM 1 | Small round green heads, about 2.5-3 cm across, bright green with slightly darker lobed tops, some with loose outer leaves and light browning at edges, clustered in the upper left of the plate; roughly 6 pieces, each holding its shape and firm-looking | 60
ITEM 2 | Sliced green stalk pieces, pale-to-bright green, crisp-looking with a fibrous surface and a pale inner core, cut into thin diagonal or chopped strips about 3-6 cm long, scattered in the upper right beside the round green heads; dry surface with no visible sheen | 45
ITEM 3 | Dark glossy oval fruits, deep purple-brown to near-black, smooth wrinkled skin with a slight sheen, each about 2-2.5 cm long, whole and unpitted, piled in the lower left center of the plate; firm, holding shape, no visible juice or dressing | 85
